title: Remove Save As entries from the schematic File menu
summary: Uses two Deletion elements in the extension's .rcs, merged at start-up through Updates = 'AdvSch', to remove Save As and Save As Copy from the schematic editor's File menu without any code.
phrasings: hide a menu item in Altium Designer
delete an entry from a built-in menu with an rcs file
remove Save As from the File menu
customize the schematic editor menu from an extension

commands.name: DisableSaveAs
commands.description: Report that Save As is disabled and which schematic File menu entries this extension removes
